thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: GPU memory pressure on pool 'dedicated-gpu-2' (CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY). PagerDuty incident fired.
pagerduty: Triggered: GPU OOM spikes - dedicated-gpu-2. Severity: P1. Incident key: PD-83421. Assigned to: eng-oncall.
alex_chang: Acked. I'm pulling logs and checking which model instances are affected.
maria_ng: I'm nearby, ping me if you need help with scaling or draining. Any customer impact visible?
samir: Seeing burst of CUDA alloc failures from several pods on node gpu-node-17. stack: `cudaMalloc` failures, then `Segmentation fault` in inference-worker.
wendy_l: Dashboard shows elevated latency for route /v1/generate (model: redwood-7b-q4f). Error rate up ~8% from baseline.
alex_chang: Dumping pods on gpu-node-17:
```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-17
inference-7b-0   Running  0/1  2d   10.2.3.45
inference-7b-1   CrashLoopBackOff  0/1  3h  10.2.3.46
kvcache-0        Running  1/1  10m 10.2.3.47
```
alex_chang: Logs from inference-7b-1 show repeated allocation failures:
```
[2026-03-14T18:12:03Z] ERROR cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-14T18:12:04Z] WARN kvcache: eviction failed: no reclaimable prefixes
[2026-03-14T18:12:05Z] FATAL inference: unhandled OOM, exiting
```
maria_ng: Looks like KV cache growth + long-running large-batch requests caused the node to run out. Any recent rollout or change to batching config?
samir: No rollout in last 24h. But traffic spike from a few high-concurrency customers (acme-co-prod, flint-ux) around 18:10 UTC. Possibly long contexts with streaming enabled.
wendy_l: Customer impact: metric shows failed requests routed to redwood-7b-q4f for those tenants. I'll open a quick customer-impact note and add affected tenant list.
alex_chang: Immediate mitigation plan:
- Step 1: Isolate node: cordon gpu-node-17 so new pods don't land.
- Step 2: Evict non-critical pods (kvcache) to free memory, then restart inference pods gracefully.
- Step 3: Scale up replacement nodes if available, and move traffic via routing policy to dedicated-gpu-1.
- Step 4: If still unstable, fallback to a lower-memory model variant (redwood-7b-q4f -> redwood-7b-q4f-lt) for those routes.
maria_ng: I'll cordon the node and evict kvcache.
samir: Doing `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` now.
infra-bot: Node gpu-node-17 cordoned by samir at 2026-03-14T18:14:20Z.
samir: Evicting kvcache pod:
```
kubectl -n inference delete pod kvcache-0 --grace-period=30
```
alex_chang: After eviction, restart inference pods one at a time to rebuild KV caches slowly.
wendy_l: I've updated routing to reduce new sessions to dedicated-gpu-2 by 60% while we stabilize (:thumbsup:).
pagerduty: Escalation: No acknowledgement from secondary pager after 5m, escalating to SRE lead.
maria_ng: I'm going to temporarily lower batch size for heavy routes (policy: batch_size_max=8 -> 4) to prevent large allocations.
alex_chang: Patch for batch config applied to canary routes. Observing memory usage on gpu-node-17 dropping slowly.
samir: inference-7b-1 restarted and came up healthy. Logs show KV cache warmed and no further cudaMalloc failures yet.
wendy_l: Error rate dropping back to baseline. Latency improving, still monitoring for 15m.
alex_chang: Customer impact note: acme-co-prod experienced 502s for ~3m window, approx 120 calls failed. Flows auto-retried by client, no data corruption. Sent initial incident email to their SRE.
maria_ng: Adding follow-up actions:
- Add automated KV cache eviction when free memory < 10%
- Add early detection: alert when batch size median > configured threshold
- Add a fallback route that switches affected tenants to lower-memory model variant automatically
wendy_l: I'll create a postmortem ticket and link telemetry: PM-3748. Assigning to alex_chang for mitigation playbook updates.
